effective.acceptance: The report's trace table has one row per rule of the Mantle specification's Mantle Ledger section (note id, service notes, channel notes, input spendability, output validation, consuming inputs, creating outputs), in the document's order, each with a file:line in the unit or an explicit 'not in unit' / 'needs external evidence'. Every confirmed code finding has a new test in logos-blockchain-ledger, logos-blockchain-core or logos-blockchain-utxotree that fails on 0.3.0 for the divergence it names. Prose-only findings are marked as such. The target implementation is unchanged.
effective.context:
Logos Blockchain is a Rust workspace (edition 2024, toolchain 1.99.0 pinned in rust-toolchain.toml, Cargo.lock committed). Package names carry a `logos-blockchain-` prefix the directory names lack; the `name` field of each crate's Cargo.toml is authoritative. The audited ref is the release tag 0.3.0 (commit 1da2d9d69a80452cf6b5d0e68304762d510c8a6c); record the resolved commit in the report. The specification in the prompt is one section of the Bedrock v1.1 Mantle specification LIP as published in the logos-lips repository at commit fddc2c1 (the 2026-10-08 Bedrock snapshot); the operations that consume and create notes are audited by their own briefs.

The section defines notes (note id, service notes, channel notes) and the ledger rules: input note spendability validation, output note validation, consuming input notes on execution, creating output notes on execution.

Where the section lives in the code:
- ledger/src/mantle/mod.rs and src/mantle/helpers.rs (package `logos-blockchain-ledger`): the Mantle ledger state (the UTXO set, locked and channel-registered notes), the spendability and output checks, and the consume and create steps. ledger/src/update.rs: the per-block update that applies them. ledger/src/lib.rs: the top-level `Ledger` and its `Balance`.
- core/src/mantle/ledger.rs (package `logos-blockchain-core`): the note and note-id types and the ledger-facing transaction view. core/src/mantle/channel_notes.rs: channel notes. core/src/sdp/service_notes.rs: service notes. core/src/mantle/fixtures/ledger.rs: ledger test builders.
- merkle/utxotree/src (package `logos-blockchain-utxotree`): the UTXO tree the ledger commits notes into.

Running tests: the gate runs the unit's packages with cargo-nextest, which is what CI uses (`.github/workflows/code-check.yml` runs the whole workspace that way; the whole workspace is too large for this container, so the gate is narrowed to the unit). `cargo nextest run --locked -p <package> --all-features` runs one package; `cargo test --locked -p <package> --all-features -- <filter>` works too. `.config/nextest.toml` marks a unit test slow after 30 s and kills it after 2 min. ZK proof dependencies come as prebuilt circuit crates (`lbc-*-sys` with the `prebuilt` feature) and the verifier links rapidsnark statically, so the first build compiles C++ and takes a while; nothing needs a running node, docker, or downloaded circuit files. New proof tests go in the owning crate's tests/ directory or as a `#[cfg(test)]` module file under src/ named by finding id. Treat code comments that cite a spec paragraph as claims to check.
